svg.title: The third week, Tuesday, 11.10
svg.desc: A department building with a photocopier conversation, a pigeonhole with one envelope, a door with the nameplate removed and a procedure pinned to a noticeboard.

g.text: Twelve things to find. Four are the claim. Four are the machinery that should have handled it.
the office, blind down at eleven
two at the photocopier, third week
the person it is about, told by a student
a timetable with one slot greyed out
a printed email, one name blacked out
